description: Single beneficiary with MAGI exactly at the top-tier limit ('greater than or equal to'): top tier.
worked:
Premium year 2026; the income-related adjustment uses MAGI from the 2024 tax return (two years back): 500,000 (adjusted gross income plus tax-exempt interest).
CMS 2026 Medicare Parts A & B premiums fact sheet, Part B table, the individual tax return column (single, head of household, qualifying surviving spouse, married filing separately and lived apart all year): 500,000 is greater than or equal to 500,000.
Part B: standard premium 202.90 + income-related adjustment 487.00 = total monthly premium 689.90.
Part D table, same row: monthly income-related adjustment 91.00 (added to the plan premium).
